ip addr del 240.127.1.1/24 dev docker0 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set docker0 down 2>/dev/null || true

ip link set eth1 nomaster 2>/dev/null || true
ip link set eth2 nomaster 2>/dev/null || true
ip link del bond0 2>/dev/null || true

ip link add bond0 type bond
echo 802.3ad > /sys/class/net/bond0/bonding/mode
echo 100 > /sys/class/net/bond0/bonding/miimon
echo fast > /sys/class/net/bond0/bonding/lacp_rate
echo layer3+4 > /sys/class/net/bond0/bonding/xmit_hash_policy

ip link set eth1 down
ip link set eth2 down
ip link set eth1 master bond0
ip link set eth2 master bond0
ip link set eth1 up
ip link set eth2 up
ip link set bond0 up

ip addr replace 172.20.0.1/30 dev bond0

ip link set eth3 up
ip addr replace 192.168.10.1/24 dev eth3

sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.bond0.forwarding=1
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.eth3.forwarding=1

ip route replace 192.168.20.0/24 via 172.20.0.2 dev bond0
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/setup-bond.sh
/usr/local/sbin/setup-bond.sh
echo EXIT=$?
commands.stdout:
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding = 1
net.ipv4.conf.bond0.forwarding = 1
net.ipv4.conf.eth3.forwarding = 1
EXIT=0
